title: Copying a word into a blank tape
statement: Let $k\ge 0$, let $x$ and $z$ be Boolean words, and let $src,dst$ be distinct work-tape indices. Suppose a configuration $d$ on input $x$ is in the sweep phase, the destination head is at cell $0$, the destination tape is blank everywhere, and the source tape agrees with the buffer storing $z$ throughout the window from cell $-1$ through cell $|z|$. After $2|z|+2$ steps of the copy machine, the destination tape stores $z$ and the machine is in the done phase. At every earlier time $s<2|z|+2$, it is not in the done phase.
hypotheses_covered: src and dst are work-tape indices
d is in the sweep phase
destination tape is blank at every integer cell
source tape agrees with the buffer of z for every integer p from -1 through |z|
